name: brim
description: UK journey-cost estimator: fuel or EV energy, tolls, and clean-air charges

scripts.deploy:all: npm run deploy:staging && npm run deploy:prod
scripts.db:generate: node scripts/with-env.mjs dev -- npx drizzle-kit generate
scripts.db:migrate:development: node scripts/with-env.mjs dev -- npx drizzle-kit migrate
scripts.db:migrate:staging: node scripts/with-env.mjs staging -- npx drizzle-kit migrate
scripts.db:migrate:production: node scripts/with-env.mjs prod -- npx drizzle-kit migrate
scripts.db:migrate:all: npm run db:migrate:development && npm run db:migrate:staging && npm run db:migrate:production
scripts.db:studio: node scripts/with-env.mjs dev -- npx drizzle-kit studio
scripts.keys:generate: node scripts/with-env.mjs dev -- node scripts/keys.mjs generate
scripts.keys:generate:staging: node scripts/with-env.mjs staging -- node scripts/keys.mjs generate
scripts.keys:generate:prod: node scripts/with-env.mjs prod -- node scripts/keys.mjs generate
scripts.keys:rotate: node scripts/with-env.mjs dev -- node scripts/keys.mjs rotate
scripts.keys:rotate:staging: node scripts/with-env.mjs staging -- node scripts/keys.mjs rotate
scripts.keys:rotate:prod: node scripts/with-env.mjs prod -- node scripts/keys.mjs rotate
scripts.test: turbo run test && node --test scripts/env-file.test.mjs scripts/vca-fetch.test.mjs scripts/keys.test.mjs scripts/cf-sync.test.mjs scripts/with-env.test.mjs && node scripts/no-em-dash.mjs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test
scripts.ship-it: npm run check && npm run build
